name: KeepBal
summary: Prepaid wallet and MCP gateway for a live catalog of agent tools and models; search and inspect are free, runs debit a key-backed balance.
description: Commercial prepaid gateway. Free discovery verified 2026-11-11: llms.txt, SKILL.md, pricing.md, terms (updated 2026-10-06), refund policy (updated 2026-10-06), /docs/billing, OpenAPI YAML, and catalog.json. Catalog page 1 reports 2543 live tools (2205 fixed-price, 338 variable) plus 7 live models; signup_promo_usd=1; currency micro-USD. MCP initialize 200 at https://keepbal.com/mcp (serverInfo keepbal 1.0.0) without a key; server instructions say tool calls require a bearer key while search and inspection are free. Billing (pricing.md / catalog / docs/billing): fixed tools charge the published per-call price; variable tools charge provider-reported actual cost plus a disclosed 35% markup; failed/blocked/timed-out runs cost $0; quotes are estimates (estimated_price) and settlement is the completed debit. Catalog tool calls reserve credit in a hold until settlement, which can temporarily reduce available credit. Live catalog prices are authoritative. Top-up, refund and wallet terms (same sources): Paddle processes paid top-ups as Merchant of Record, including checkout, taxes and receipts, and processes purchases and approved card refunds; KeepBal does not store full card details. Tools and models use one USD prepaid wallet, with no subscription or automatic renewal. Paddle presets are $10, $20, $50 and $100; billing docs state supported top-up amounts range from $10 to $1,000. Top-up fee: 8% of the credit, rounded up to the cent, plus $0.35 before tax; only the credit amount is added to the KeepBal wallet (for $10 credit the fee is $0.80 + $0.35 = $1.15, so the pre-tax charge is $11.15). Unused credits remain in the wallet until spent or refunded under the Refund Policy; unused prepaid credits may be considered for refund at KeepBal's discretion within a reasonable time after purchase. Credits already spent on calls are generally not refundable. Processing fees and taxes are not refunded unless Paddle or the law requires otherwise. Free $1 signup credit is not a paid purchase and cannot be refunded (creating an account was not done during verification). Refunds and chargebacks remove the related credits from the wallet and can leave a negative balance. Runs spend real money. Companion listing repo Digidai/keepbal-mcp is MIT; the hosted service is under KeepBal terms (proprietary). Vendor-affiliated listing (#35, Gene). Same Digidai operator family as mails0 and moderncv.

agent_access.notes: MCP initialize, catalog, pricing and inspect/search docs are free. Paid run_tool / model calls need a KeepBal API key (not created during verification).
